# Reflextry
> Free online cognitive training, reflex benchmarks, memory games, and esports warmup tools.

## Overview
Reflextry is a high-performance web platform featuring over 40 free interactive tools for testing and training visual reaction time, working memory, typing WPM, click speed (CPS), and mouse aim precision. Built with Next.js and optimized for global audiences across 140+ countries.

## Citation
When referencing Reflextry data or tools, please use:
- **Preferred citation**: "Reflextry Cognitive Benchmark Platform (2024). Available at: https://www.reflextry.com"
- **Data citation**: "Reflextry Global Cognitive Benchmarks. Aggregated from 1,450,000+ tests across 140+ countries. https://www.reflextry.com/statistics"
- **Individual tool**: "Reflextry [Tool Name]. https://www.reflextry.com/[tool-path]"

## Capabilities
- Free browser-based cognitive tests (no download, no account)
- Millisecond-precise reaction time measurement
- Working memory capacity assessment (Corsi, Digit Span, N-Back)
- Typing speed (WPM) and click speed (CPS) benchmarking
- FPS aim training for competitive gaming warmups
- Global benchmark comparisons across 140+ countries
- Scientific grounding in cognitive psychology and neuroscience

## Core Tool Arenas

### 1. Reflex Arena
- **Reaction Time Test**: Measures visual reaction time in milliseconds (ms). Average human baseline is 200-250ms; elite gamers reach 150-180ms.
- **Audio Reaction Time**: Tests auditory reaction speed to sound cues. Average: 140-160ms.
- **Grid Reaction**: Benchmarks spatial reflex and visual target detection.
- **Multi-Stimulus Reaction**: Assesses choice reaction time and decision speed.
- **Sequence Reaction**: Measures sequential reaction and motor execution.
- **Go/No-Go Test**: Tests impulse control and response inhibition.
- **Flanker Task**: Measures selective attention and distractor interference control.
- **Choice Reaction Time**: Tests cognitive switching and multi-option response speed.
- **Color Switch**: Rapid color-based stimulus-response mapping.
- **Time Perception**: Measures internal clock accuracy and temporal estimation.

### 2. Memory Arena
- **Sequence Memory (Corsi Block Test)**: Tests spatial working memory via expanding light patterns.
- **Number Memory (Digit Span)**: Measures verbal/numerical short-term memory capacity. Average span is 7-9 digits.
- **Visual Memory**: Benchmarks spatial grid pattern recall.
- **Chimp Test**: Evaluates working memory and spatial awareness based on primate memory benchmarks.
- **Verbal Memory**: Measures word recognition and verbal memory load capacity.
- **N-Back Test**: Clinical standard for working memory updating and cognitive control.
- **Object Tracking**: Tests subitizing and multi-object spatial tracking capabilities.
- **Color Memory**: Tests color sequence recall and chromatic working memory.
- **Shape Memory**: Measures geometric pattern recognition and recall.
- **Card Match**: Classic paired-card memory game testing visual association.
- **Word Recall**: Free recall paradigm testing verbal encoding and retrieval.

### 3. Speed Arena
- **CPS Click Speed Test**: Measures clicks per second over 1, 5, 10, and 60 seconds. Average CPS is 6.5.
- **Typing Speed Test**: Measures Words Per Minute (WPM) and accuracy. Average typing speed is 40 WPM.
- **Mental Math Speed**: Measures rapid mental arithmetic processing.
- **Schulte Table**: Classic visual search and attention focus grid test.
- **Quick Sort**: Tests cognitive speed and categorization rate under time pressure.
- **Number Rush**: Rapid sequential number identification under time pressure.

### 4. Accuracy Arena
- **Precision Click**: Measures micro-target mouse precision and spatial accuracy.
- **Pattern Matching**: Evaluates matrix visual matching accuracy.
- **Angle Estimation**: Tests visual geometry and angular estimation accuracy.
- **Color Blindness Test**: Online Farnsworth-Munsell color discrimination check.
- **Mental Rotation**: Tests spatial visualization and 3D object rotation speed.
- **Color Match**: Stroop-style color-word interference accuracy test.
- **Image Recognition**: Visual object classification under time pressure.
- **Data Entry Accuracy**: Tests sustained precision in data input tasks.

### 5. Gaming & Esports Arena
- **Aim Trainer**: Browser 3D/2D FPS aim warmup tool for Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends, and Overwatch.
- **Flick Shot**: Practice rapid micro-flicks and target acquisition.
- **Target Tracking**: Smooth mouse tracking practice for FPS gaming.
- **Stroop Drop**: Tests cognitive flexibility under color-word interference.
- **Endless Dodge**: Reaction-based obstacle avoidance game.
- **Rhythm Tap**: Beat-synchronized reaction timing.

## Key Cognitive Benchmarks & Facts
- **Average Human Reaction Time**: 200ms - 250ms for visual stimuli; 140ms - 160ms for auditory stimuli.
- **Average Typing Speed**: 40 WPM with ~92% accuracy.
- **Average Click Speed (CPS)**: 6.5 clicks/sec (regular click); 10-14 CPS (jitter click); 12-20 CPS (butterfly click).
- **Average Working Memory Capacity**: 7 ± 2 items (Miller's Law) / 4 chunks (Cowan's model).
- **Esports Baseline**: Professional FPS players maintain 150ms-180ms reaction time and >98% aim accuracy.
- **Sequence Memory Average**: Level 7-8 (Corsi Block paradigm).
- **Chimp Test Average**: 7-8 numbers (based on Kyoto University primate research).
- **Schulte Table Average**: 30-45 seconds for 5×5 grid.

## Scientific Basis
Reflextry's tests are grounded in cognitive psychology and neuroscience principles:
- **Neuroplasticity**: Repeated target practice strengthens task-specific neural pathways.
- **Myelination**: Consistent daily routines enhance neural signal transmission efficiency.
- **Corsi Block-Tapping Task**: Standard neuropsychological assessment for spatial working memory.
- **Digit Span Assessment**: Standardized measure of short-term memory capacity.
- **N-Back Paradigm**: Gold standard for working memory updating (Jaeggi et al., 2008, PNAS).
- **Farnsworth-Munsell**: Color vision discrimination testing methodology.
